exposure: third-trimester drop of 15% or more in total insulin requirements
outcome: cesarean birth for fetal wellbeing concerns
cohort: 350 pregnant people (146 with type 1 diabetes and 204 with type 2 diabetes) who were followed at a tertiary referral center in Toronto, Canada.
finding: A third-trimester drop of 15% or more in total insulin requirements was not associated with the subsequent occurrence of adverse pregnancy outcomes in individuals with pre-existing diabetes.
mod_finding: A third-trimester drop in insulin requirements was not associated with an increased risk of cesarean birth for fetal wellbeing concerns, as this was part of the composite primary outcome which showed no difference.
